# API reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-api-docs.mjs from the packages' .d.ts files — do not edit by hand. -->

Every signature below is extracted from the types the packages actually ship. Renderer packages re-export the whole engine, so engine functions can be imported from any of them.

## @stacklatte/chart-engine

Platform-agnostic logic: indicators, viewport math, geometry, themes and the ChartConfig pipeline. Zero dependencies.

### Functions

```ts
abbrevName(name: string): string
```
Abbreviate an indicator name to at most 3 uppercase characters.

```ts
applyZoomOutResistance(requestedRange: number, maxVisible: number): number
```
Applies rubber-band-style resistance once a requested zoom-out range exceeds `maxVisible`, instead of a hard clamp. A hard `Math.min(requestedRange, maxVisible)` makes zooming out feel like hitting a wall — the range stops responding at all the instant the ceiling is reached. This keeps the range responsive-but-diminishing past the ceiling, asymptotically settling at `maxVisible * (1 + SOFT_ZOOM_OUT_RATIO)` rather than ever exceeding it outright. Below `maxVisible` this is the identity function — resistance only ever kicks in past the legible ceiling, never inside it.

```ts
buildCandleGeometry(data: Candle[], width: number, height: number, priceMin: number, priceMax: number, colorUp?: string, colorDown?: string): CandleBar[]
```
Compute pixel geometry for every candle.

```ts
buildChartPipeline(config: ChartConfig, data: Candle[], options?: ValidateOptions): CompiledChart
```
Full pipeline: validate → normalize → compile.

```ts
buildLinePoints(data: Candle[], width: number, height: number, priceMin: number, priceMax: number): Point[]
```
Convert candle close prices to pixel coordinates for a line-chart.

```ts
buildMacdHistogramBars(histogram: { timestamp: number; value: number; }[], indexByTimestamp: Map<number, number>, total: number, width: number, height: number, yMin: number, yMax: number, zeroY: number): MacdHistogramBar[]
```
Convert MACD histogram TsPoints into pixel-rect geometry ready for any renderer.

```ts
buildMarkerPoints(markers: ChartMarker[], indexByTimestamp: Map<number, number>, total: number, width: number, height: number, priceMin: number, priceMax: number): MarkerPoint[]
```
Map ChartMarkers to pixel coordinates using the exact same functions the candle layer uses (getCandleX/getY), so markers stay pixel-perfect through pan/zoom/live updates.

```ts
buildPaddedRange(priceMin: number, priceMax: number, paddingRatio?: number): { min: number; max: number; }
```
Adds symmetric padding around a raw price range so candles don't sit flush against the top and bottom edges of the chart.

```ts
buildSeriesPoints(data: TsPoint[], indexByTimestamp: Map<number, number>, total: number, width: number, height: number, min: number, max: number): Point[]
```
Convert time-series points to pixel coordinates.

```ts
buildShadedAreaPoints(from: TsPoint[], to: TsPoint[], indexByTimestamp: Map<number, number>, total: number, width: number, height: number, min: number, max: number): { top: Point[]; bottom: Point[]; }
```
Build the top and bottom edge points for a shaded band (e.g. Bollinger Bands fill).

```ts
buildTimestampIndex(candleData: Candle[]): Map<number, number>
```
Build a timestamp → array-index lookup for fast O(1) mapping. Pre-build this once per visible-candle set and pass it to the series builders.

```ts
buildVolumeBars(data: Candle[], width: number, height: number, yMax: number, colorUp?: string, colorDown?: string): VolumeBar[]
```
Convert per-candle volume into pixel-rect geometry, one bar per candle, anchored to the panel's bottom edge (yMin is always 0). Missing `volume` is treated as 0. Bars are 60 % of the candle slot width, centred on the candle X position — same proportions as buildCandleGeometry.

```ts
calcBollingerBands(candles: Candle[], period: number, multiplier: number, colors: { upper: string; lower: string; basis: string; }): { upper: IndicatorLine; lower: IndicatorLine; basis: IndicatorLine; } | null
```
Bollinger Bands: a `period`-candle SMA (`basis`) with `upper` / `lower` bands `multiplier` standard deviations away (population standard deviation, O(n) sliding window). Returns three `IndicatorLine`s — pair `upper` and `lower` in a `ShadedArea` for the classic filled band — or `null` when there are fewer candles than `period` or `period` is not a positive integer.

```ts
calcEMA(candles: Candle[], period: number, id: string, color: string): IndicatorLine | null
```
Exponential moving average of `close` (smoothing 2 / (period + 1)), seeded with the SMA of the first `period` closes. The first point is at candle `period - 1`. Returns `null` when there are fewer candles than `period` or `period` is not a positive integer.

```ts
calcMACD(candles: Candle[], fastPeriod?: number, slowPeriod?: number, signalPeriod?: number): MacdResult | null
```
MACD(12,26,9): classic momentum oscillator.

```ts
calcRSI(candles: Candle[], period?: number): RsiPoint[]
```
Relative Strength Index with Wilder smoothing. Returns one point per candle after the first `period` candles, values in [0, 100] (100 when there are no losses). Returns `[]` when there are fewer than `period + 1` candles or `period` is not a positive integer — it never throws.

```ts
calcSMA(candles: Candle[], period: number, id: string, color: string): IndicatorLine | null
```
Simple moving average of `close` over `period` candles, as an overlay line. The first point is at candle `period - 1`. Returns `null` when there are fewer candles than `period` or `period` is not a positive integer. `id` is the key `ShadedArea` refers to; `color` is any CSS color.

```ts
calcVWAP(candles: Candle[], id: string, color: string): IndicatorLine | null
```
Volume-weighted average price, cumulative over the supplied candles: `Σ(typicalPrice × volume) / Σ(volume)` where `typicalPrice = (high + low + close) / 3`. There is one point per candle from the first candle that has volume > 0. Candles without a (finite, positive) `volume` are skipped until volume appears. Returns `null` when no candle has volume. For a session VWAP, pass only that session's candles. Never throws.

```ts
clampTickX(x: number, width: number, margin?: number): number
```
Clamp a time-axis tick X so its label never renders too close to the chart edges.

```ts
clampViewport(viewport: CandleViewport, dataLength: number, minVisibleCandles: number): CandleViewport
```
Clamp a CandleViewport so it stays within the available data and the visible range stays between minVisibleCandles and dataLength.

```ts
closesToCandles(closes: readonly number[], opts?: { endTs?: number; intervalMs?: number; }): Candle[]
```
Turn a plain list of prices (oldest first) into chart data, for static data such as a stock list's last 30 closes. Each point becomes a flat candle (open = high = low = close), `intervalMs` apart, ending at `endTs` (default: now). Non-finite values are skipped.

```ts
compileChartConfig(config: ChartConfig, data: Candle[]): CompiledChart
```
Compile a ChartConfig + raw candle data into ChartProps ready for ChartCanvas.

```ts
computeBufferWindow(effectiveStart: number, zoomLevel: number, intervalMs: number, bufferRatio: number, prevAnchor: number | null, timeMin: number, timeMax: number, safeMarginRatio?: number): BufferWindow
```
Computes the buffered time window around the current viewport.

```ts
computeCustomPanelYRange(yRange: "auto" | { min: number; max: number; } | undefined, series: TsPoint[][], referenceLines?: number[]): { yMin: number; yMax: number; }
```
Resolve the Y axis range for a custom panel: the caller's fixed `yRange` if given (e.g. a correlation coefficient's natural -1..1), otherwise auto-computed from the panel's own visible series data and reference lines, padded 10% via the same `buildPaddedRange` the main price panel uses — so an empty or single-value panel still gets a sane, non-zero-height range.

```ts
computeLayout(width: number, height: number, showRsiPanel: boolean, showMacdPanel?: boolean, showVolumePanel?: boolean, customPanelCount?: number): ChartLayout
```
Pixel layout of a chart: plot width, and the heights of the main panel and each sub-panel. Sub-panels (volume, RSI, MACD, custom) share one height of 60–110 px (18% of the plot height), each separated by `panelGap`. Sizes never go below 1 px, so tiny containers cannot produce negative canvas sizes. `mainCanvasHeight` includes the top padding and the time-axis gutter.

```ts
computeMacdYRange(macd: TsPoint[], signal: TsPoint[], histogram: TsPoint[]): { yMin: number; yMax: number; }
```
Compute the Y axis range for a MACD panel.

```ts
computePinchDistance(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): number
```
Euclidean distance between two touch points — the input to `computePinchZoom`.

```ts
computePinchZoom(currentZoom: number, initialDistance: number, newDistance: number, min?: number, max?: number): number
```
New zoom level (visible candle count) after a pinch: `currentZoom / (newDistance / initialDistance)`, clamped to [`min`, `max`]. Spreading fingers (distance grows) zooms in (fewer candles). Returns `currentZoom` when either distance is not positive.

```ts
computePriceRange(visibleCandles: Candle[]): { priceMin: number; priceMax: number; }
```
Lowest `low` and highest `high` of the given candles. Returns `{ priceMin: 0, priceMax: 1 }` for an empty array. Candles must be finite — pass the output of `normalizeCandles`.

```ts
computeScrollBounds(bufferStartTs: number, firstDataTs: number, lastDataTs: number, timeWindow: number, intervalMs: number, slotWidth: number): { minTranslateX: number; maxTranslateX: number; latestStart: number; }
```
Computes the scroll translate X bounds so the user cannot drag into empty space beyond the first or last candle.

```ts
computeSparklineLayout(width: number, height: number): ChartLayout
```
Layout for `sparkline` mode: the plot fills the whole box (2 px breathing room), no axis gutters and no sub-panels.

```ts
computeTimeShift(dx: number, timeWindow: number, chartWidth: number, effectiveStart: number): number
```
Returns the new scrollStartTime after a drag.

```ts
computeViewport(sortedData: Candle[], zoomLevel: number, intervalMs: number, scrollStartTime: number | null, isFollowingLive: boolean): ViewportWindow
```
Time window shown for a given zoom level (candle count) and interval. While `isFollowingLive` (or `scrollStartTime` is null) the window ends at the last candle; otherwise it starts at `scrollStartTime`, clamped so it never scrolls past the data.

```ts
computeVolumeYRange(candles: Candle[]): { yMin: number; yMax: number; }
```
Compute the Y axis range for a volume panel.

```ts
computeXGeometry(effectiveZoomLevel: number, chartWidth: number, intervalMs: number, bufferStartTs: number, timeMin: number, bufferedCount: number): { slotWidth: number; virtualWidth: number; bufferOffsetX: number; }
```
Computes the pixel geometry for the buffer/virtual canvas.

```ts
crosshairAtIndex(idx: number, visibleCandles: Candle[], totalVisible: number, chartWidth: number, priceMin: number, priceMax: number, chartHeight: number): { x: number; y: number; candle: Candle; }
```
Crosshair position for the candle at `idx` (clamped into range): x is the candle slot centre, y is the close price mapped into the plot. Returns the candle too.

```ts
detectLiveUpdateMode(prevCandle: Candle | null, lastCandle: Candle | null, prevLen: number, nextLen: number): LiveUpdateMode
```
Compares the previous and current last candle to determine what kind of live update just arrived.

```ts
extendToEdges(series: TsPoint[], leftTs: number, rightTs: number): TsPoint[]
```
Extend a series so it visually fills the entire visible candle window. Adds a leading point at leftTs and/or a trailing point at rightTs when the series doesn't already reach those edges. This is a rendering trick — it does NOT recompute the indicator.

```ts
filterByWindow<T extends { timestamp: number; }>(data: T[], leftTs: number, rightTs: number): T[]
```
Filter an array to the timestamps in [leftTs, rightTs], inclusive. O(log n + k) for ordered input (binary search). Input need not be ordered — markers and indicator series supplied in any order are sorted (once, cached) rather than silently dropped.

```ts
findIndicatorById(indicators: IndicatorLine[] | undefined, id: string): IndicatorLine | undefined
```
Find an indicator by id. Returns undefined if not found.

```ts
findIndicatorValue(data: TsPoint[], timestamp: number): number | null
```
Look up an indicator's value at a specific timestamp. Returns null if no matching point is found.

```ts
findMarkerAt(points: MarkerPoint[], x: number, y: number, radius?: number): MarkerPoint | null
```
Finds the MarkerPoint nearest to (x, y), within `radius` pixels, or null if none are close enough. Drives the hover (web) / tap (native) tooltip — a plain linear nearest-within-radius scan, which is plenty fast since marker counts are small (dozens to low hundreds of trades, not thousands).

```ts
formatTimeLabel(ts: number, totalSpanMs: number, hour12?: boolean): string
```
Formats a timestamp for a time-axis label, adapting to the total visible time span.   < 10 s   → HH:MM:SS  (sub-second intervals)   < 24 h   → HH:MM  (or h:MM AM/PM when hour12=true)   < 7 d    → ddd HH:MM   < 1 y    → MMM DD   ≥ 1 y    → MMM YYYY  (a bare "MMM DD" would be ambiguous once ticks span multiple years —                         e.g. "Jan 03" recurring every year — so the year is included instead)

```ts
getCandleX(index: number, total: number, chartWidth: number): number
```
Candle X: centers the position within the candle slot. Good for candle bodies and wicks.

```ts
getMarkerKindLabel(kind: MarkerKind): string
```
Human-readable fallback heading for a marker's hover/tap tooltip, used when the caller didn't set ChartMarker.label.

```ts
getMarkerStyle(kind: MarkerKind, colors: ChartThemeColors): MarkerStyle
```
Resolves a MarkerKind to its default shape + color.

```ts
getPriceTicks(min: number, max: number, count: number): number[]
```
"Nice" horizontal grid prices between `min` and `max`, about `count` of them (steps of 1, 2, 5 × 10ⁿ). Returns `[]` for an empty, reversed or non-finite range, never loops forever.

```ts
getSeriesX(index: number, total: number, chartWidth: number): number
```
Series X: edge-based positioning. First point lands at x=0, last point lands at x=chartWidth. Good for indicator lines and shaded areas so they reach plot edges.

```ts
getThemeColors(theme: ChartTheme | ChartThemeColors): ChartThemeColors
```
Resolve a theme name or a custom color object into a full ChartThemeColors. Falls back to "dark" for unknown preset names.

```ts
getTimeTicks(sortedData: Candle[], viewportStart: number, viewportEnd: number, intervalMs: number, chartWidth: number, hour12?: boolean): { x: number; label: string; ts: number; }[]
```
Time-based sliding grid — the correct approach for trading charts.

```ts
getY(value: number, min: number, max: number, chartHeight: number): number
```
Maps a price value to a Y pixel coordinate. Higher prices = smaller Y (top of chart).

```ts
indexFromViewX(viewX: number, paddingLeft: number, chartWidth: number, totalVisible: number): number
```
Index of the visible candle under an x pixel position (clamped to the plot). Use it to map a pointer to a candle for crosshair inspection.

```ts
inferIntervalMs(sortedData: Candle[]): number | undefined
```
Infers the data interval from the median gap between adjacent timestamps. Using the median rather than the first two points makes it robust against gaps at the start of the series (e.g. weekend breaks, missing data). Returns undefined when fewer than 2 points are available.

```ts
maxLegibleVisibleCandles(chartWidth: number, minVisibleCandles: number): number
```
The most candles `chartWidth` px can show while keeping each candle slot at least `MIN_PX_PER_CANDLE` wide.

```ts
normalizeCandles(candles: Candle[]): Candle[]
```
Prepare raw candles for rendering: drop undrawable candles (non-finite timestamp or price — one bad tick would otherwise turn the whole price range into NaN and blank the chart), strip non-finite volume, sort by timestamp and dedupe (first occurrence wins). Always returns a new array; never mutates the input.

```ts
normalizeChartConfig(config: ChartConfig): ChartConfig
```
Apply defaults and clamp out-of-range values. Always returns a structurally valid, fully-labeled config.

```ts
parseDashArray(dash: string): number[]
```
Parse an SVG-style dash string (e.g. "4 4") into a number array suitable for Skia's DashPathEffect intervals.

```ts
precomputeYRanges(bufferedCandles: Candle[], effectiveZoomLevel: number): { min: number; max: number; }[]
```
Precomputes the padded Y range (min/max with 8% padding) for every possible viewport start slot in `bufferedCandles`.

```ts
prepareIndicatorData(line: IndicatorLine, leftTs: number, rightTs: number): TsPoint[]
```
Filter an indicator's data to the window then extend to both edges.

```ts
priceTickCount(chartHeight: number, minPx?: number): number
```
Returns how many price ticks fit in a given pixel height without overlapping. Each label needs at least minPx vertical pixels.

```ts
resolveIntervalMs(intervalMsProp: number | undefined, sortedData: Candle[]): number
```
Candle interval in ms: the explicit `intervalMsProp` if given, else the median gap between candles, else 60 000 (1 minute).

```ts
resolveYRange(candleData: Candle[], yMin?: number, yMax?: number): { min: number; max: number; }
```
Resolve the Y axis min/max for a layer. Falls back to the candle price range when explicit overrides are not provided.

```ts
sameOhlc(a: Candle | null, b: Candle | null): boolean
```
Returns true only when two candles share identical OHLC values. Used to detect live mutations vs. genuine new data.

```ts
softZoomOutCeiling(maxVisible: number): number
```
The absolute ceiling `applyZoomOutResistance` asymptotically approaches but never reaches — use this (not `maxVisible` itself) as the outer `clampViewport`/`clamp` bound so the resisted range is never truncated back down to a hard wall by a later clamp.

```ts
validateChartConfig(config: ChartConfig, options?: ValidateOptions): ValidationResult
```
Validate a ChartConfig document.

```ts
withAlpha(color: string, alpha: number): string
```
`rgba()` of a CSS colour at the given alpha. Handles #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa and rgb()/rgba(); anything else is returned as is.

### Interfaces

#### `BollingerOverlay`

Bollinger Bands is a multi-line indicator: one computation pass produces three lines (upper / lower / basis). Each band has its own id and color so that ShadedAreaConfig can fill the upper → lower region, and each band can be styled independently.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `"bollinger_bands"` | yes | Bollinger Bands: expands to three lines (upper, lower, basis). |
| `params` | `BollingerParams` | yes | `{ period, stdDev }` — period integer 1–500, stdDev in (0, 10]. |
| `bands` | `{ upper: { id: string; color: PaletteColor; label?: string; }; lower: { id: string; color: PaletteColor; label?: string; }; basis: { id: string; color: PaletteColor; label?: string; }; }` | yes | Each band needs its own unique id; use the upper/lower ids in a `shadedAreas` entry to fill between them. |

#### `BollingerParams`

Parameters for Bollinger Bands.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | `number` | yes | Lookback period in bars. |
| `stdDev` | `number` | yes | Standard deviation multiplier for the upper/lower bands. Typical values: 1.5 – 3.0. |

#### `BufferWindow`

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bufferStartTs` | `number` | yes |  |
| `bufferEndTs` | `number` | yes |  |
| `anchor` | `number` | yes | Updated anchor — write this back to your prevAnchor ref each render. |

#### `Candle`

One OHLC(V) bar. All prices must be finite numbers; candles with a non-finite timestamp or price are dropped by `normalizeCandles` (which every renderer applies), so one bad tick cannot blank a chart.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `timestamp` | `number` | yes | Bar open time in Unix milliseconds. Candles may arrive unsorted or duplicated; renderers sort and dedupe. |
| `open` | `number` | yes | Price at bar open. |
| `high` | `number` | yes | Highest price of the bar (must be ≥ open and close). |
| `low` | `number` | yes | Lowest price of the bar (must be ≤ open and close). |
| `close` | `number` | yes | Price at bar close — the value line charts, indicators and the crosshair use. |
| `volume` | `number` | no | Traded volume. Optional; required only for the volume panel. Non-finite values are stripped. |

#### `CandleBar`

Full geometry for a single candlestick bar, ready to hand to any renderer.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | `number` | yes | Center X of the candle slot |
| `wick` | `{ y1: number; y2: number; }` | yes | Wick: y1 = high pixel (smaller y), y2 = low pixel (larger y) |
| `body` | `{ y: number; height: number; }` | yes | Body: top-left y and height in pixels |
| `width` | `number` | yes | Body width in pixels |
| `up` | `boolean` | yes | true = bullish (close ≥ open) |
| `color` | `string` | yes | Resolved fill/stroke color — comes from the caller's theme |

#### `CandleViewport`

Floating-point candle index viewport used by the chart renderer. `start` and `end` are indices into sortedData (may be fractional).

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `number` | yes | Index of the left-edge candle (inclusive, may be fractional) |
| `end` | `number` | yes | Index past the right-edge candle (exclusive, may be fractional) |

#### `ChartConfig`

ChartConfig is the single document consumed by the chart pipeline:   validateChartConfig → normalizeChartConfig → compileChartConfig → ChartCanvas

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `"1"` | yes | Schema version. Must be '1'. The pipeline rejects unknown versions. |
| `theme` | `ThemePreset` | yes | `"dark"` or `"light"`. |
| `priceDisplay` | `PriceDisplay` | yes | `"candle"` or `"line"` (close-price line). |
| `interval` | `ChartInterval` | yes | Candle interval label: `1m 5m 15m 30m 1h 4h 1d 1w`. |
| `overlays` | `OverlayConfig[]` | yes | Indicator lines rendered on top of the price series. |
| `shadedAreas` | `ShadedAreaConfig[]` | yes | Filled regions between pairs of overlay lines. |
| `subPanels` | `SubPanelConfig[]` | yes | Oscillator panels rendered below the main chart. |
| `markers` | `MarkerConfig[]` | no | Trade/event markers drawn on the main price panel. Defaults to [] when omitted. |
| `viewport` | `ViewportConfig` | yes | Zoom and follow-live behaviour. |
| `hud` | `HudConfig` | yes | HUD / crosshair settings. |

#### `ChartLayout`

Pixel geometry of a chart, from `computeLayout`. The plot size is always ≥ 1 px; hidden sub-panels are 0.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `padding` | `ChartPadding` | yes | Gutters around the main plot. |
| `chartWidth` | `number` | yes | Plot width (total width minus the price-axis gutter). |
| `panelGap` | `number` | yes | Vertical gap between stacked panels. |
| `innerHeight` | `number` | yes | Total height available to the main plot plus all sub-panels (excludes the padding). |
| `rsiPanelHeight` | `number` | yes | Height of the RSI panel (0 when hidden). |
| `macdPanelHeight` | `number` | yes | Height of the MACD panel (0 when hidden). |
| `volumePanelHeight` | `number` | yes | Height of the volume panel (0 when hidden). |
| `customPanelHeight` | `number` | yes | Shared height for every custom panel (see `CustomPanel`) — same "equal share, shrinks as more panels are shown" sizing as RSI/MACD/Volume, since custom panels are just more entries in the same stack, not a separate sizing tier. |
| `mainChartHeight` | `number` | yes | Height of the main price plot after the sub-panels are subtracted. |
| `mainCanvasHeight` | `number` | yes | Full height of the main chart canvas including padding (use for Canvas/Svg height prop) |

#### `ChartMarker`

A single point-in-time annotation drawn on the price panel (e.g. a backtest's entry/exit points). Rendered by MarkerLayer/draw/markers.ts using the same pixel math as the candle layer, so it stays in sync through pan/zoom/live updates with no external state.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `timestamp` | `number` | yes | Candle time (Unix ms) the marker is pinned to. Markers outside the visible window are not drawn. |
| `price` | `number` | yes | Price level (same units as the candles) the marker sits at. |
| `kind` | `MarkerKind` | yes | Determines the glyph and color: entry/exit long/short, stop-loss, take-profit. |
| `label` | `string` | no | Tooltip heading. Falls back to a name derived from `kind` (e.g. "Stop-loss") if omitted. |
| `changePct` | `number` | no | Optional % change shown in the tooltip (e.g. a closed trade's P&L%), colored up/down like the OHLC HUD's change row. |

#### `ChartPadding`

Space reserved around the plot area (right = price-axis gutter, bottom = time-axis gutter), in px.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `top` | `number` | yes |  |
| `right` | `number` | yes |  |
| `bottom` | `number` | yes |  |
| `left` | `number` | yes |  |

#### `ChartProps`

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `Candle[]` | yes | The candles to draw. May be unsorted, duplicated or contain bad values — renderers normalise it (`normalizeCandles`). `[]` renders a "No data" placeholder. |
| `indicators` | `IndicatorLine[]` | no | Overlay lines on the price panel (see `calcSMA`, `calcEMA`, `calcBollingerBands`). |
| `shadedAreas` | `ShadedArea[]` | no | Filled regions between two `indicators` (matched by id). |
| `markers` | `ChartMarker[]` | no | Trade/event markers drawn on the main price panel. |
| `customPanels` | `CustomPanel[]` | no | Arbitrary named sub-panels for data that doesn't fit `indicators` (wrong scale) or the fixed RSI/MACD/Volume panels (wrong shape) — see `CustomPanel`. |
| `width` | `number` | yes | Total chart width in CSS pixels (the plot is narrower by the price-axis gutter). |
| `height` | `number` | yes | Total chart height in CSS pixels, including every sub-panel and the time axis. |
| `intervalMs` | `number` | no | Milliseconds per candle. If omitted the chart auto-detects the interval from the gap between the first two candles in `data`. |
| `visibleDataPoints` | `number` | no | Number of data points visible on screen at once. Default: 60. |
| `theme` | `ChartTheme \| ChartThemeColors` | no | Named preset ("dark" \| "light") or a custom ChartThemeColors object. |
| `showOhlcHud` | `boolean` | no | Show the OHLC readout and enable the crosshair that follows the pointer / touch. Default: false. |
| `showRsiPanel` | `boolean` | no | Show an RSI sub-panel (period: `rsiPeriod`) with 30/70 thresholds. Default: false. |
| `rsiPeriod` | `number` | no | RSI lookback period. Default: 14. Only used when showRsiPanel is true. |
| `showMacdPanel` | `boolean` | no | Show a MACD(12,26,9) sub-panel (lines + histogram). Needs at least ~35 candles of data, otherwise it is omitted. Default: false. |
| `showVolumePanel` | `boolean` | no | Show a volume sub-panel below the main chart. Requires `data[].volume`. Default: false. |
| `chartType` | `ChartType` | no | `'candle'` (default), `'line'` (close-price line) or `'area'` (the line with a gradient fill underneath, in the theme's `lineChart` colour). |
| `sparkline` | `boolean` | no | Compact mode for lists of many small charts (stock tickers, table cells): no axis labels, grid, price gutter, sub-panels, crosshair or tooltip, and the chart does not capture touch, wheel or pointer events, so a page full of them still scrolls. Draws the whole dataset as an `area` unless `chartType` says otherwise. Use with a small `width` / `height` (e.g. 120 × 36). |
| `scrollToLatestTrigger` | `number` | no | Increment this value to jump the viewport to the latest candle. |
| `onCrosshairChange` | `(candle: Candle \| null) => void` | no | Called with the inspected candle while the crosshair is active, and with `null` when it is released. Requires `showOhlcHud`. |
| `bufferRatio` | `number` | no |  |
| `hour12` | `boolean` | no | Use 12-hour (AM/PM) time format on the X axis. Default: false (24-hour). |
| `maxZoom` | `number` | no | Maximum number of candles the user can zoom out to see at once. Defaults to the full dataset length so the user can never zoom past all available data. Set a lower value to restrict the zoom range. |
| `showGrid` | `boolean` | no | Show background grid lines on the chart. Default: true. Axis labels are always shown regardless of this setting. |

Full color palette consumed by every chart layer.

| property | type | required | description |

| `background` | `string` | yes | Canvas / outer background |
| `gridH` | `string` | yes | Horizontal dashed price-grid lines |
| `gridV` | `string` | yes | Vertical dashed time-grid lines |

| `timeLabel` | `string` | yes | X-axis time labels |
| `crosshair` | `string` | yes | Crosshair hair lines |
| `candleUp` | `string` | yes | Bullish (close ≥ open) candle body + wick |
| `candleDown` | `string` | yes | Bearish (close < open) candle body + wick |
| `lineChart` | `string` | yes | Line-chart stroke |
| `rsiLine` | `string` | yes | RSI indicator line |
| `rsiThreshold` | `string` | yes | RSI overbought/oversold threshold lines (70 / 30) |
| `hudBackground` | `string` | yes | OHLC HUD overlay background |
| `hudText` | `string` | yes | OHLC HUD text |
| `markerNeutral` | `string` | yes | Neutral trade-marker color (exit-long / exit-short) — not tied to bullish/bearish |

#### `CustomPanel`

One named sub-panel of caller-supplied data that doesn't fit an existing overlay or fixed panel type (RSI/MACD/Volume) — e.g. a correlation coefficient, an external data series, or any strategy-specific signal the caller has already computed. Unlike `indicators` (which overlay the main price panel and assume a price-like scale), a `CustomPanel` gets its own scaled sub-panel, the same visual treatment RSI/MACD/Volume already get.

| property | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Unique panel id (used as the DOM/React key). |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Human-readable panel name shown in the OHLC HUD. |
| `series` | `IndicatorLine[]` | yes | Usually one line, but multiple series can share a panel (e.g. two correlated indicators on the same scale) — each is drawn with its own `IndicatorLine.color`. |
| `yRange` | `"auto" \| { min: number; max: number; }` | no | `'auto'` (default) computes the range from the panel's own visible data, padded — same convention as the main price panel. Provide fixed bounds for a panel with a natural fixed scale (e.g. a -1..1 correlation coefficient never needs to auto-range). |
| `referenceLines` | `number[]` | no | Horizontal reference lines (e.g. 0 for a correlation panel) — the same visual idea as RSI's 30/70 threshold lines, generalized to any value(s) instead of a fixed pair. |

| property | type | required | description |

| `type` | `"ema"` | yes | Exponential moving average of close. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Must be unique within this config. Referenced by ShadedAreaConfig. |
| `params` | `PeriodParams` | yes | `{ period }` — integer 1–500. |
| `color` | `PaletteColor` | yes | Named palette color (never a raw hex string). |
| `label` | `string` | no | Defaults to "EMA {period}" when omitted. |

### Types

- `export type ChartConfigVersion = typeof CHART_CONFIG_VERSION;`
- `export type ChartInterval = '1m' | '5m' | '15m' | '30m' | '1h' | '4h' | '1d' | '1w';` — Named time intervals. Use these instead of raw millisecond numbers. The compiler maps them to millisecond values via INTERVAL_MS.
- `export type ChartTheme = 'light' | 'dark';` — Named built-in theme presets.
- `export type ChartType = 'candle' | 'line' | 'area';` — How the price series is rendered in the main panel. `area` is the smooth close-price line with a gradient fill underneath.
- `export type CompiledChart = Omit<ChartProps, 'width' | 'height'>;` — ChartProps without layout dimensions — those come from the container at runtime.
- `export type LiveUpdateMode = 'none' | 'mutate-last-candle' | 'append-new-candle';` — Describes how the latest candle changed since the previous render.
- `export type MarkerKind = 'entry-long' | 'exit-long' | 'entry-short' | 'exit-short' | 'stop-loss' | 'take-profit';` — Closed union of supported trade-marker kinds — same convention as OverlayType/ChartType.
- `export type MarkerKindConfig = 'entry-long' | 'exit-long' | 'entry-short' | 'exit-short' | 'stop-loss' | 'take-profit';` — Closed union of supported trade-marker kinds — mirrors ChartMarker's MarkerKind.
- `export type MarkerShape = 'triangle-up' | 'triangle-down' | 'x' | 'dot';` — Shapes MarkerLayer / draw/markers.ts know how to draw.
- `export type OverlayConfig = SmaOverlay | EmaOverlay | BollingerOverlay | VwapOverlay;`
- `export type OverlayType = 'sma' | 'ema' | 'bollinger_bands' | 'vwap';` — All valid overlay type discriminators.
- `export type PaletteColor = 'blue' | 'orange' | 'green' | 'red' | 'purple' | 'yellow' | 'cyan' | 'pink' | 'white' | 'gray';` — Named color tokens. Use these instead of raw hex strings. The compiler resolves each token to an exact hex value via PALETTE.
- `export type PriceDisplay = 'candle' | 'line' | 'area';` — How the price series is rendered in the main panel.
- `export type RsiPoint = { timestamp: number; value: number; };` — One RSI value (0–100) aligned to a candle timestamp.
- `export type SubPanelConfig = RsiPanelConfig | MacdPanelConfig | VolumePanelConfig;` — Union of all sub-panel types.
- `export type SubPanelType = 'rsi' | 'macd' | 'volume';` — All valid sub-panel type discriminators.
- `export type ThemePreset = 'dark' | 'light';` — Visual theme preset for the chart.
- `export type TsPoint = { timestamp: number; value: number; };` — A value aligned to a candle timestamp — the building block of every indicator series.
- `export type ValidationErrorCode = 'INVALID_VERSION' | 'DUPLICATE_OVERLAY_ID' | 'SHADED_AREA_UNKNOWN_REF' | 'SHADED_AREA_SELF_REF' | 'INVALID_OPACITY' | 'INVALID_VISIBLE_CANDLES' | 'INVALID_PERIOD' | 'INVALID_STD_DEV' | 'INVALID_MARKER_TIMESTAMP' | 'INVALID_MARKER_PRICE' | 'INVALID_MARKER_KIND' | 'INVALID_ENUM' | 'UNKNOWN_KEY' | 'INVALID_STRUCTURE' | 'INVALID_TYPE';`
- `export type ValidationResult = { valid: true; } | { valid: false; errors: ValidationError[]; };` — Discriminated result — check `valid` before using `errors`.

### Constants

- `CHART_CONFIG_VERSION`: `"1"` — ChartConfig — versioned, LLM-safe schema for chart configuration.
- `INTERVAL_MS`: `Record<ChartInterval, number>`
- `MACD_COLORS`: `{ readonly line: "#2196F3"; readonly signal: "#FF9500"; readonly histPos: "#2ECC71"; readonly histNeg: "#E74C3C"; }` — Fixed colors for the MACD sub-panel.
- `MARKER_HIT_RADIUS`: `12` — Default hit-test radius for findMarkerAt() — deliberately larger than MARKER_SIZE. The 7px marker shape is precise to draw but too small a target to reliably hover/tap; a generous radius keeps the tooltip usable without visually enlarging the marker itself.
- `MARKER_SIZE`: `7` — Fixed pixel size for trade markers — deliberately does not scale with zoom.
- `MIN_PX_PER_CANDLE`: `3` — Minimum candle-slot pixel width before candles, their gaps, and the gridlines behind them become illegibly dense. Used as the implicit zoom-out ceiling whenever a caller doesn't pass a smaller `maxZoom` — without it, zooming out (wheel/pinch) is only bounded by `dataLength`, so a chart with a lot of data zoomed out on a fixed-width canvas degrades into a hairline smear with an overcrowded axis. Deliberately a pixel width, not a fixed candle count, so the ceiling scales with the chart's actual rendered width.
- `PALETTE`: `Record<PaletteColor, string>`
- `RSI_MAX`: `100` — RSI is always rendered on a fixed 0–100 scale.
- `RSI_MIN`: `0` — RSI is always rendered on a fixed 0–100 scale.
- `THEMES`: `Record<string, ChartThemeColors>` — Named theme registry. Add new themes here and they become available via the `theme` prop.

## @stacklatte/chart-engine/canvas

Canvas 2D renderer shared by `chart-react` and `chart-angular`: the drawing primitives and `ChartController`. A separate entry point so the main engine entry stays DOM-free.

Also re-exports everything from `@stacklatte/chart-engine` (see above).

### Classes / components

#### `ChartController`

Framework-agnostic chart: `new ChartController(hostElement, props)`, then `update(props)` on every change and `destroy()` when done. Owns the canvases, pan / pinch / wheel gestures and the crosshair.

| member | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `update` | `update(next: ChartProps): void` | Apply new props (cheap to call on every change). |
| `flush` | `flush(): void` | Paints right now if a repaint is pending, instead of waiting for the next animation frame. Wrappers that must be visually up to date as soon as their own update returns (e.g. React's layout effect) call it after `update()`. |
| `getVisibleMarkers` | `getVisibleMarkers(): MarkerPoint[]` | The trade markers currently inside the visible window, with `x` / `y` in the host element's pixel coordinate space (the same space as `PointerEvent.offsetX` on the chart). Use it to place your own overlays next to markers. Empty until the first paint. |
| `destroy` | `destroy(): void` | Removes the chart's DOM, event listeners and any pending animation frame. Call when the host is torn down. |

### Functions

```ts
drawAxis(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, opts: AxisDrawOptions): void
```
Draws the price axis (right gutter), time axis (bottom), and — when `showGrid` — the dashed grid, onto a 2D context in CSS-pixel coordinates.

```ts
drawCandles(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, bars: CandleBar[]): void
```
Draws candle bodies and wicks from geometry produced by `buildCandleGeometry`.

```ts
drawCrosshairDot(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, point: Point, color: string, radius?: number): void
```
A filled dot with a contrasting ring, marking a series value under the crosshair.

```ts
drawCrosshairLines(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, opts: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; color: string; dash?: number[]; }): void
```
Dashed horizontal + vertical crosshair lines through (x, y) across the plot.

```ts
drawCustomPanel(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, opts: { series: { color: string; data: TsPoint[]; }[]; candleData: Candle[]; width: number; height: number; yMin: number; yMax: number; referenceLines?: number[]; colors: ChartThemeColors; }): void
```
Draws a `CustomPanel`'s series, fixed or auto y-range and reference lines into its own sub-panel.

```ts
drawLineSeries(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, pts: Point[], color: string, lineWidth?: number): void
```
Strokes a smooth Catmull-Rom curve through the points (used for line charts and indicator overlays).

```ts
drawMacdPanel(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, opts: { macd: TsPoint[]; signal: TsPoint[]; histogram: TsPoint[]; candleData: Candle[]; width: number; height: number; colors: ChartThemeColors; }): void
```
Draws MACD and signal lines plus the histogram (green above zero, red below) into the MACD sub-panel.

```ts
drawMarkers(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, opts: { markers: ChartMarker[]; candleData: Candle[]; width: number; height: number; priceMin: number; priceMax: number; colors: ChartThemeColors; }): void
```
Draws trade markers (triangles, stop/take-profit glyphs) pinned to their candle and price.

```ts
drawRsiPanel(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, opts: { data: RsiPoint[]; candleData: Candle[]; width: number; height: number; colors: ChartThemeColors; }): void
```
Draws the RSI line (0–100) with its 30/70 threshold lines into the RSI sub-panel.

```ts
drawShadedArea(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, top: Point[], bottom: Point[], color: string, opacity: number): void
```
Fills the polygon between a `top` and `bottom` point series (see `buildShadedAreaPoints`).

```ts
drawVolumePanel(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, opts: { candleData: Candle[]; width: number; height: number; colors: ChartThemeColors; }): void
```
Draws volume bars coloured by candle direction into the volume sub-panel.

```ts
fillPolygon(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, pts: Point[], opts: { color: string; opacity?: number; }): void
```
Fills a closed polygon through the given points.

```ts
getScaledContext(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, cssWidth: number, cssHeight: number): CanvasRenderingContext2D | null
```
Sizes a <canvas> backing store for the device pixel ratio and returns a context pre-scaled to CSS-pixel coordinates, so every draw helper in this package can work in the same logical-pixel space chart-native uses.

```ts
strokeDashedLine(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, p1: Point, p2: Point, opts: { color: string; lineWidth?: number; dash?: number[]; }): void
```
Strokes a straight dashed line between two points.

```ts
strokeSmoothPath(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, pts: Point[], opts: { color: string; lineWidth?: number; }): void
```
Strokes a cubic-bezier curve passing exactly through every point (Catmull-Rom, tension 1/6).

## @stacklatte/chart-angular

Angular standalone component `<sl-chart>`. Re-exports the whole engine.

Also re-exports everything from `@stacklatte/chart-engine` (see above).

### Classes / components

#### `SlChartComponent`

`<sl-chart>` — Stacklatte trading chart for Angular (standalone component).

| member | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | `Candle[]` | The candles. May be unsorted/duplicated/dirty — they are normalised. |
| `width` | `number` | Chart width in CSS pixels. |
| `height` | `number` | Chart height in CSS pixels (including sub-panels). |
| `indicators` | `IndicatorLine[] \| undefined` | Overlay lines on the price panel (`calcSMA`, `calcEMA`, `calcBollingerBands`). |
| `shadedAreas` | `ShadedArea[] \| undefined` | Filled regions between two `indicators` (matched by id). |
| `markers` | `ChartMarker[] \| undefined` | Trade markers (entry / exit / stop-loss / take-profit). |
| `customPanels` | `CustomPanel[] \| undefined` | Your own named sub-panels for data that fits no built-in panel. |
| `intervalMs` | `number \| undefined` | Milliseconds per candle; auto-detected from the data when omitted. |
| `visibleDataPoints` | `number \| undefined` | How many candles are visible at once. Default 60. |
| `theme` | `ChartTheme \| ChartThemeColors \| undefined` | `'dark'` (default), `'light'`, or a full `ChartThemeColors` object. |
| `chartType` | `ChartType \| undefined` | `'candle'` (default) or `'line'`. |
| `showOhlcHud` | `boolean` | Show the OHLC + indicator readout (the same HUD as React / React Native: change %, OHLC, volume, RSI, one row per indicator) and enable the crosshair. |
| `showRsiPanel` | `boolean \| undefined` | Show an RSI sub-panel. |
| `rsiPeriod` | `number \| undefined` | RSI lookback period. Default 14. |
| `showMacdPanel` | `boolean \| undefined` | Show a MACD(12,26,9) sub-panel. |
| `showVolumePanel` | `boolean \| undefined` | Show a volume sub-panel (needs `volume` on the candles). |
| `showGrid` | `boolean \| undefined` | Background grid lines. Default true. |
| `sparkline` | `boolean \| undefined` | Compact mode for lists of small charts: no axes, panels, crosshair or event capture. Draws the whole dataset as an area. |
| `hour12` | `boolean \| undefined` | 12-hour time labels on the x-axis. Default false. |
| `maxZoom` | `number \| undefined` | Maximum candles visible when zoomed out. |
| `scrollToLatestTrigger` | `number \| undefined` | Increment to jump the viewport to the latest candle. |
| `crosshairChange` | `i0.EventEmitter<Candle \| null>` | Emits the inspected candle while the crosshair is active, `null` when it is released. |
| `ngOnChanges` | `ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void` | A callback method that is invoked immediately after the default change detector has checked data-bound properties if at least one has changed, and before the view and content children are checked. |
| `getVisibleMarkers` | `getVisibleMarkers(): MarkerPoint[]` | The trade markers currently on screen, with `x` / `y` in this component's pixel space — handy for placing your own overlays next to markers. Empty until the first paint. |
| `ngOnDestroy` | `ngOnDestroy(): void` | A callback method that performs custom clean-up, invoked immediately before a directive, pipe, or service instance is destroyed. |
